title: Manufactures, arts et métiers
note: Volume 3 of 4 of Manufactures, arts et métiers, issued as part of the Encyclopédie méthodique, ou par ordre de matières (Paris: Panckoucke; Liège: Plomteux). The plates belong to the companion Recueil de planches de l'Encyclopédie (1783-1790). Publication is staggered across the set: vol. 1 in 1785, vol. 2 in two parts (1784-1790), vol. 3 in 1790, vol. 4 in 1828; this item is dated 1784. Volume 3 covers C-D of the alphabetical sequence. A dictionary of arts, industrial arts, and technology.

title: Problems in Solid State Physics
note: Edited volume in the Advances in Science and Technology Physics Series, comprising ten papers by Soviet scientists on submillimetre dielectric spectroscopy, magnetoelectric effects in crystals, ferroelectromagnetics, high hydrogen pressures and hydrides, dislocations in semiconductors, InGaAsP heterojunctions, acoustoelectronic interaction, laser crystals and glasses, polymer etching, and coil-globule transitions. Translated from the Russian by Ram S. Wadhwa.

title: Report of the Commission on Industrial and Technical Education
authors: Massachusetts. Commission on Industrial and Technical Education
note: Commission members include Carroll Davidson Wright (chair), Sir William Mather, and E. Swaysland. Contains the Commission's report, the sub-committee's report on the relation of children to the industries, and appendices including "Industrial education in Europe". Subject headings: Technical education; Child labor. Part of the same Massachusetts industrial-education series as Dearle (1914) and Montague (1887) in this set.

title: Industrial Training: With Special Reference to the Conditions Prevailing in London
note: Subject headings: Technical education; Manual training; Child labor. A study of technical and manual training as practised in London, read alongside the Massachusetts commission's 1906 report and Montague's 1887 summary of the Royal Commission in this set.

title: Technical Education: A Summary of the Report of the Royal Commission Appointed to Inquire into the State of Technical Instruction
note: viii, 68 p., published for the Cobden Club. A summary of the Royal Commission on Technical Instruction's report, in the series of British technical-education inquiries that also includes the Massachusetts commission's 1906 report and Dearle's 1914 study. One of the earliest modern treatments of technical instruction in Britain; relevant background to the 1910 Nature news item "Technical Education in Germany and the United Kingdom".
